<thought>To find a suitable single-step retrosynthetic transformation, I will search the template catalog for reactions where a ketone and an alkyne are broken in the forward direction (i.e., they appear as precursors). This matches the hint that the forward cycloaddition loses a ketone and a C‑C triple bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
